description: Volcanic-associated massive sulphide (VMS) mineralization in the Yukon-Tanana Terrane and coeval strata of the North American miogeocline, in the Yukon and adjacent areas is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Discovery of the volcanic-associated massive sulphide (VMS) Kudz Ze Kayah (KZK) deposit in 1994, closelyfollowed by the discovery of the Wolverine VMS deposit, resulted in a period of intense exploration activity in Yukon. This led to the discovery of additional VMS mineralization that includes GP4F, Ice and significant new reserves at Fyre Lake. Coverage: Government of Yukon. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Its tags are ygs-import, ygs-import-20250711, ygs-publications, yukon-geological-survey, importation d'ygs. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
